execution_policy.replay_rule: Run the maximum honest verifiable historical subset immediately. Do not block the entire replay solely because a perfect official dated PIT universe manifest is unavailable.
execution_policy.calibration_rule: Only VERIFIED coverage samples may enter final calibration/OOS validation. PARTIAL samples are research-only; UNKNOWN samples are excluded.
execution_policy.survivorship_rule: Retain later-delisted/failed assets whenever historical archive evidence is available; if completeness cannot be demonstrated, label SURVIVORSHIP_INCOMPLETE_MVP and do not claim Full-Universe validation.
execution_policy.announcement_role: Listing/delisting announcements are cross-check evidence, not the primary universe source.
execution_policy.anti_stall_acceptance: Each execution must attempt to produce numeric universe_size, scanned_count, coverage_ratio and Raw N/Effective N where computable. If these remain null/zero, record the concrete data/acquisition blocker and next executable remediation; architecture redesign is not a valid substitute.
